final_resume.summary: Full-stack engineer with Java/Spring Boot backend and React frontend experience, and an earlier QA role.

bullets: Built Spring Boot services for shipment tracking that process 2 million events a day from Kafka.
Developed React and TypeScript screens for the dispatcher console used by 300 operators.
Containerised 5 services with Docker and deployed them to Kubernetes on AWS.
Designed and implemented contract tests between the tracking API and console, catching 9 breaking changes before release and ensuring code quality through rigorous testing.
Automated 80 checkout regression tests using Selenium and Java, reducing manual testing effort and improving release confidence.
Executed JMeter load tests for high-traffic festive-sale release, validating system performance under peak conditions.

profile_improvement_tips: Learn Python or C++ and build a small project to demonstrate proficiency; both are explicitly listed in the JD minimum qualifications.
Formalise your System Design knowledge by studying distributed systems patterns (e.g., eventual consistency, sharding, replication) and document a design review you led or participated in.
Highlight code review leadership: add a bullet describing a code review initiative, feedback framework, or mentoring activity that improved team code quality.
final_resume.growth_note: You have strong full-stack and distributed systems fundamentals (Kafka, Kubernetes, microservices), but the JD lists Python and C++ as preferred languages. Gaining hands-on experience in at least one of these will significantly strengthen your candidacy for Google Cloud roles.
